mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id AS "roleId",r.data_scope_cd AS "dataScope",r.snstv_view_yn='Y' AS "sensitiveView" FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT a.menu_id AS "menuId",bool_or(a.inq_yn='Y') AS "inquire",bool_or(a.reg_yn='Y') AS "register", bool_or(a.upd_yn='Y') AS "update",bool_or(a.del_yn='Y') AS "delete",bool_or(a.upld_yn='Y') AS "upload", bool_or(a.dnld_yn='Y') AS "download",bool_or(a.cnfm_yn='Y') AS "confirm" FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN tb_sy_role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN tb_sy_menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.menu_lvl=2 WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY a.menu_id ORDER BY a.menu_id
SELECT proj_id AS "projectId",scope_sn::integer AS "scopeSn" FROM tb_sy_user_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND proj_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY proj_id,scope_sn

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.role_id) FROM tb_sy_role r JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId}), 'links',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ur) ORDER BY ur.role_id) FROM tb_sy_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId}), 'permissions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.role_id,a.menu_id) FROM tb_sy_role_menu_auth a JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=a.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId}), 'menus',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.menu_id) FROM tb_sy_menu m), 'scopes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.scope_sn) FROM tb_sy_user_scope s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId}), 'leadership',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.part_id,s.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_bs_part_std s WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{userId}) )::text
